title: PolyStepRow
html:
定义组：System F 双绑定替换与规约。有序参数：z2139、z2140、z2141。

两种根 β 的完全兼容一步闭包。：单行局部条件。

规范公式

(@ PolyStepRow z2139 z2140 z2141) 按 无捕获缩写规则 展开为下列有限公式。参数只取集合，不能填入函数项或元语言公式。

(exists t
  (exists u
    (and
      (@ Pair t u z2141)
      (and
        (@ PolyAny t)
        (and
          (@ PolyAny u)
          (or
            (exists z2144
              (exists z2145
                (exists z2146
                  (exists z2147
                    (exists z2148
                      (and
                        (@ Num0 z2144)
                        (and (@ TLam z2146 z2147 z2145) (and (@ TApp z2145 z2148 t) (@ PolyTermInst z2144 z2144 z2148 z2147 u)))))))))
            (or
              (exists z2144
                (exists z2145
                  (exists z2147
                    (exists z2146
                      (and
                        (@ Num0 z2144)
                        (and (@ FTAbs z2147 z2145) (and (@ FTInst z2145 z2146 t) (@ PolyTypeInstTerm z2144 z2146 z2147 u))))))))
              (or
                (exists z2146
                  (exists z2147
                    (exists z2153
                      (and
                        (@ TLam z2146 z2147 t)
                        (and
                          (@ TLam z2146 z2153 u)
                          (exists z2154
                            (exists z2155 (and (in z2154 z2140) (and (@ App z2139 z2154 z2155) (@ Pair z2147 z2153 z2155))))))))))
                (or
                  (exists z2149
                    (exists z2150
                      (exists z2151
                        (and
                          (@ TApp z2149 z2150 t)
                          (and
                            (@ TApp z2151 z2150 u)
                            (exists z2156
                            (exists z2157 (and (in z2156 z2140) (and (@ App z2139 z2156 z2157) (@ Pair z2149 z2151 z2157))))))))))
                  (or
                    (exists z2149
                      (exists z2150
                        (exists z2152
                          (and
                            (@ TApp z2149 z2150 t)
                            (and
                            (@ TApp z2149 z2152 u)
                            (exists z2158
                            (exists z2159 (and (in z2158 z2140) (and (@ App z2139 z2158 z2159) (@ Pair z2150 z2152 z2159))))))))))
                    (or
                      (exists z2147
                        (exists z2153
                          (and
                            (@ FTAbs z2147 t)
                            (and
                            (@ FTAbs z2153 u)
                            (exists z2160
                            (exists z2161 (and (in z2160 z2140) (and (@ App z2139 z2160 z2161) (@ Pair z2147 z2153 z2161)))))))))
                      (exists z2149
                        (exists z2151
                          (exists z2146
                            (and
                            (@ FTInst z2149 z2146 t)
                            (and
                            (@ FTInst z2151 z2146 u)
                            (exists z2162
                            (exists z2163 (and (in z2162 z2140) (and (@ App z2139 z2162 z2163) (@ Pair z2149 z2151 z2163)))))))))))))))))))))
